Name: Biblically Accurate Fairy Box
Author: EmeraldCeihan
Description:
[u]Features:[/u]
1. Several different color choice (Green, Blue, and Gold). New color (Purple, Pink, and Red)
2. Optional eyeball forms in two selectable shapes (Round and Oval)
3. Matching item icon with gold Yoba Vessel box

[u]Known Bug:[/u]
1. Gold color is no longer selectable when other color selected. Solution: Reset to default on config setting.
2. Red color is not on the config color selections list. Solution: Try to select other color other than default (Gold).

[u]Known Mod Conflict:[/u]
Any mod that may alter Fairy Box Trinket assets

[u]Thanks to:[/u]
ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, Pathoschild for Content Patcher, and spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config

[u]NOTE:
[/u]- BE NOT AFRAID
- PRAISE THE YOBA
